steps.what: Show the stored electrical engineering plan.
Review electrical engineering plans against design specifications and codes.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the electrical engineering plan and the design specification already stored. The engineering technician reviews the plan for adherence to that specification and the applicable code. The screen does not decide compliance. Only the review the technician accepts is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A plan was marked compliant because a limit field was filled, and nobody had reviewed the drawing.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored plan can be opened. The code review still belongs to the technician.
tasks.still_hard: A clash the stored limit does not mention still has to be seen on the plan.
tasks.human_edge: The technician reviews the plan. The stored limit is not the compliance decision.
tasks.altitude: The review stays with the technician. It is filed only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Issue the plan that is about to be reviewed.
reach.learn: A title is not code compliance.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored electrical plan is a lookup. It does not decide that the plan meets the design specification or the code.
A safety judgement on an electrical installation is not an automatic decision. The technician remains responsible for the code review.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An engineering technician in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the circuit, and a draft is not the accepted record.

Fields: The plan id and the design specification already stored. The compliance judgement is not added by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the plan in the document store before the review.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the engineering technician.
unknowns: Whether every applicable code is stored as a limit on the plan, or only named in the specification.
research_questions: Who confirms which electrical code applies to this plan?

already_counted.description: Reviewing the plan against the specification and the code stays with the technician.

incremental.description: Drop plans whose project record has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: plan id and the review sentence the technician accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still reviews the electrical engineering plan for adherence to the design specification and the applicable code. Only opening a plan that was already stored, and filing the review already accepted, is removed. A filled limit saves none of that judgement.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored blueprint or wiring diagram.
Read blueprints, wiring diagrams, or schematic drawings.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the blueprint, wiring diagram, schematic drawing, or engineering instruction already stored. The engineering technician reads it before electronics units are assembled. The title block does not say how the unit goes together. A file with no drawing id leaves the reading with the technician.
tasks.previous_blocker: An assembler started from a title block, and the wiring note on the sheet was missed.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored drawing can be opened. The reading still belongs to the technician.
tasks.still_hard: A note the title block does not mention still has to be seen on the sheet.
tasks.human_edge: The technician reads the drawing. The file is the sheet already stored.
tasks.altitude: Reading stays with the technician. Opening the sheet does not replace it.

reach.task: Issue the drawing that is about to be read.
reach.learn: A title block is not the reading.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored blueprint, wiring diagram, or schematic is a lookup. It does not read the sheet or apply electronic theory.
A title block extracted from a drawing is not the instruction for assembling the unit.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An engineering technician in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the circuit, and a draft is not the accepted record.
Fields: The drawing id already stored. The reading is not added by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the drawing in the document store before asking for a second copy.
unknowns: Whether blueprints and engineering instructions share one record type.
research_questions: Who marks a drawing as the current sheet for this electronics unit?

already_counted.description: Reading the drawing or instruction stays with the technician.

incremental.description: Drop drawings whose unit record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still reads the blueprint, wiring diagram, schematic, or engineering instruction and still applies that reading to the assembly. Only opening a sheet that was already stored is removed. A title block saves none of the reading.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored assembly instruction for this unit.
Assemble, test, or maintain circuitry or electronic components.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the engineering instruction, technical manual, or knowledge note already stored. The engineering technician assembles, tests, or maintains the circuitry or electronic components with hand or power tools. The instruction does not hold the tool. A test station that already runs is not this time.
tasks.previous_blocker: A unit was marked tested because the station had a record, and the technician had not assembled it.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored instruction can be opened. The assembly, test, and maintenance still belong to the technician.
tasks.still_hard: A fault the instruction does not name still has to be found on the bench.
tasks.human_edge: The technician assembles and tests. The instruction is the note already written.
tasks.altitude: Assembly, testing, and maintenance stay with the technician. The stored instruction is only visible.

reach.task: Write the instruction this technician is still responsible for following.
reach.learn: An instruction title is not the assembly.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored instruction is a lookup. It does not assemble, test, or maintain circuitry.
Time a test station already spends recording a result is not the technician's assembly labour.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An engineering technician in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the circuit, and a draft is not the accepted record.
Fields: The instruction id already stored. The screen does not mark the unit assembled or tested. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the instruction in the document store before the bench work.
A test station, drawing tool, controller, bill generator, or statistical program that already runs is not in these shares.
unknowns: Whether technical manuals and engineering instructions share one record.
research_questions: Who confirms the instruction matches the unit on the bench?

already_counted.description: Assembling, testing, and maintaining the circuitry stay with the technician.

incremental.description: Drop instructions whose unit record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still assembles, tests, or maintains the circuitry or electronic components with tools. Only opening an instruction that was already stored is removed. A test station that already runs saves none of that bench work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Copy stored test results into the system log.
Maintain manuals that document equipment testing or operation.

tasks.design: The {DATA_PLATFORM} holds the test id, result, and time already recorded. Those three fields are copied into the system log, and a missing result stops the copy. The engineering technician writes the manual note of how the equipment was tested or operated. Only the log the technician accepts is filed. The recorder's own runtime is not this time.
tasks.previous_blocker: A log was filed from a test id, and the result field and the operation note were empty.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored test results can be copied into the log. The manual note still belongs to the technician.
tasks.still_hard: An operation the result field does not describe still has to be written by the technician.
tasks.human_edge: The technician documents the operation. The copied result is not that note.
tasks.altitude: The manual stays with the technician. The log is filed only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Use a log this technician has accepted.
reach.learn: A test id is not the operation note.

evidence.claim: Copying a stored test id, result, and time into a log is arithmetic on fields that already exist. It does not write the manual.
A recorder that already stores the test result is not the technician's time, and an empty result is not a result.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An engineering technician in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the circuit, and a draft is not the accepted record.

Fields: The test id, the result, and the time already stored. A missing result stops the copy. The manual sentence is not added by the copy. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Copy the three stored fields. Do not draft the manual from an empty result.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the engineering technician.
A test station, drawing tool, controller, bill generator, or statistical program that already runs is not in these shares.
unknowns: Whether operation notes and test results share one log record.
research_questions: Who may accept a log when the operation note describes a failed test?

already_counted.description: Writing the manual of the test or the operation stays with the technician.

incremental.description: Drop log rows whose equipment record has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: test id, result, time, and the manual sentence the technician accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still writes the manual that documents testing or operation of the equipment. Only copying a test id, result, and time that were already stored, and filing the log already accepted, is removed. An empty result saves none of the writing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The engineering technician still reviews the plan against the code, still reads the drawing, still assembles the circuit, and still writes the log. A stored sheet can be opened. It does not do that work.
reach: Design engineers issue a plan, and this job learns a title is not the code review.
Assemblers use an instruction this technician has already read, and the file is not the assembly.
skills_to_grow: Review a plan against the code, rather than treating a stored limit as the decision.
Read the drawing before assembling, and do not treat the title block as the reading.
Write the log from the test that happened, not from an empty result field.
role.ambitious_version: Code review, reading, assembly, and the log stay with the technician. A stored plan or result only shows what was already written.

job.title: Electrical and Electronic Engineering Technologists and Technicians
